hooks.text: 平台格斗式连招可斩击、重砸、击飞并把敌人撞上墙面
hooks.excerpt: Spiritfall is a fast-paced Action Roguelite with combat inspired by Platform Fighters. Slash, smash, launch, and wall-splat a multitude of enemies using an ever-changing arsenal of divine powers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 150余种神灵赐福可自由实验并寻找协同，形成不同战术路线
hooks.excerpt: The divine spirits offer powerful blessings that enhance your abilities in combat. Discover your favorite abilities, and experiment with different builds. With over 150+ blessings to choose from, these gifts allow for a range of tactical approaches that encourage you to find synergies that fit your playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 死亡后在圣所重生，并把本轮资源投入技能、独特能力和专属动作武器的永久成长
hooks.excerpt: Death is but a temporary setback. Reawaken stronger than before at the Sanctum and continue your adventure. Use the resources you gathered to upgrade your skills, unlock unique powers, and awaken mighty weapons with unique movesets.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
